method: Byte-for-byte deployment of the downloaded light-theme reference endpoints and transition cells.

mapping.transitions: Reference compact names are renamed to transition-{from}-{to}-{step}.webp; file contents are unchanged.
mapping.neutralPoster: portrait-neutral.webp is an exact copy of reference center.webp.
mapping.reversePlayback: The same three canonical-edge cells are read in reverse order.

processing.atlas: The 57 exact source cells are decoded, packed into an 8x8 transparent canvas, and encoded as one lossy-alpha WebP.
processing.runtimePoster: The center cell is encoded with the same runtime WebP settings as the atlas.

removedSet.status: No generated Sid endpoint or transition remains in the deployed V13 feature.
